description: Seed metadata for the Review Workbench prototype. Lists the canonical statuses and the directories where generated outputs would live if/when the workbench begins writing to disk in a future version.
notes: v0.1 does NOT write to disk — edits and outputs live in the browser tab only.
Use the Save .md button to download the editor's contents to your computer.
Use the Copy button on the Placement Map to copy the generated JSON elsewhere.
